title: Tag Groups
content_html:
Tag Groups

Capability

/studio/tag-groups/ is the read-only taxonomy reference. It shows the configured short and long description for each tag group in Studio tag-policy order.

It does not edit group identity or policy. Group descriptions come from studio/data/canonical/tags/tag-groups.json; group order and coverage participation come from studio/data/config/tags/tag-management.json; allowed registry groups are enforced by registry policy/model validation.

Execution Path

tag-groups.html
  -> tag-groups.js
  -> studio-tag-data.js
  -> GET /studio/api/tags/tag-groups
  -> tag-groups.json
  + analysis.groups ordering from runtime config

The route has no commands and never sets busy. Its Studio ready-state root moves to list or empty after load.

Code Map

  • template: studio/app/frontend/routes/tag-groups.html
  • controller: studio/app/frontend/js/tag-groups.js
  • shared selectors/styles: studio/app/frontend/js/tag-ui.js, studio/app/assets/css/studio-tags.css
  • API read map: studio_tags_api.py::READ_ENDPOINTS
  • canonical prose: studio/data/canonical/tags/tag-groups.json
  • order/coverage policy: studio/data/config/tags/tag-management.json

Change Method

  • prose change: edit tag-groups.json;
  • display order or coverage membership: edit Studio tag policy and scoring tests;
  • new group identity: treat it as a registry-model change, then update descriptions, policy, UI/scoring assumptions, imports, and tests together.

Do not use this page as a second exhaustive list of group values. Current JSON and config show the exact set.
